title: Start with zero replicas
caption: A sleeping function still has an HTTP address.
voice: This is the SlimFaas Live Stream dashboard. Fibonacci has a route, a queue, and right now, zero running replicas.

title: One request wakes one replica
caption: The caller waits for the pod to become ready.
voice: One synchronous call asks for Fibonacci of ten. SlimFaas holds the request while Kubernetes starts a pod. The caller gets fifty-five.

title: Idle again
caption: After the idle timeout, the deployment returns to zero.
voice: Watch the replica count. When the idle timeout expires, Kubernetes scales the deployment back down to zero.

title: Thirty requests arrive together
caption: Each asks for Fibonacci(48). HTTP 202 means queued.
voice: Now thirty clients ask for Fibonacci of forty-eight. Each gets an accepted response while the actual computation waits in the queue.

title: The backlog wakes more workers
caption: A queue-depth trigger scales the deployment out.
voice: As the backlog grows, the scaling rule requests more pods. Each ready worker takes one computation at a time.

title: Buffer the spike, then scale down
caption: Bounded concurrency gives the infrastructure time to catch up.
voice: The queue absorbs the spike so all thirty computations do not compete for CPU at once. When the work drains and traffic stops, the workers go back to zero.

title: Four replicas, four local caches
caption: Two evaluator pods and two audit pods cache a tool catalog.
voice: Consider an agent system. Two evaluator replicas and two audit replicas each cache a tool catalog. When a tool changes, every local copy needs invalidating.

title: One event reaches all four replicas
caption: Broadcast a tool-catalog change to every ready subscriber.
voice: One publish event fans out to both deployments. All four running replicas discard their own cached copy.

title: One result, two subscriptions
caption: Each subscribed function tracks its own progress.
voice: A completed agent result is different. Both the evaluator and the audit function need that result, but their replicas share the work within each function.

title: One replica per function, per attempt
caption: Independent acknowledgements let each function resume. Retries are possible.
voice: One replica in each deployment handles this delivery. Each function acknowledges independently. Delivery is at least once, so handlers should tolerate seeing the same result again.
